name: scene_batch_11
title: Card scenes, batch 11
intro: Keep or reject each scene, in the C and E mix. Each tile is the bare scene over two real cards, a program or event and a building, composed at 300 dpi with the full bleed showing: the program window is the whole scene, the building window its center. Scenes are a pool: the card a scene was written for is a suggestion. The second card only shows the other window. For true size, print art-originals/scenes/b11/cards.pdf at 100%. Use the notes for what to change.

rows.label: 1. Industry: A heavy industrial production line feeding chip trays into a ring of shielded magnets, a single bright point held at its center.
rows.note: Written for Antiproton Foundry. Shown on Prefab Plant Kit and Antiproton Foundry. Tile on: keep. Tile off: reject.

rows.label: 2. Power: A small collider ring threaded through a dim server hall, fiber bundles glowing violet along it, an engineer reading a terminal.
rows.note: Written for Dark Fiber Collider. Shown on Shared Compute Grant and Dark Fiber Collider. Tile on: keep. Tile off: reject.

rows.label: 3. Power: A neutral-flagged vault of shielded flasks behind glass, two delegations signing a ledger at a long table before it.
rows.note: Written for Treaty Isotope Bank. Shown on Summit Caucus and Treaty Isotope Bank. Tile on: keep. Tile off: reject.

rows.label: 4. Science: Rows of tall cylindrical magnetic traps in a clean white hall, each holding a faint violet glow, a technician logging one by hand.
rows.note: Written for Penning Trap Array. Shown on Predictive Modeling and Penning Trap Array. Tile on: keep. Tile off: reject.

rows.label: 5. Science: A cold vault of steaming liquid-nitrogen dewars on steel shelves, a researcher in thick gloves lifting out a frosted sample rack.
rows.note: Written for Cryo Sample Vault. Shown on Dataset Scraper and Cryo Sample Vault. Tile on: keep. Tile off: reject.

rows.label: 6. Science: A small field lab tent on a muddy street corner, two scientists running a portable analyzer while a patrol waits beside them.
rows.note: Written for Field Assay Team. Shown on Recruit Operatives and Field Assay Team. Tile on: keep. Tile off: reject.
